Welcome to the most natural, exotic and sweet experience in the sea

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built=”1″ admin_label=”POLICIES” _builder_version=”4.16″ locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_row _builder_version=”4.27.4″ module_alignment_tablet=”left” module_alignment_phone=”left” module_alignment_last_edited=”off|desktop” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”4_4″ _builder_version=”4.16″ custom_padding=”|||” global_colors_info=”{}” custom_padding__hover=”|||”][et_pb_accordion open_toggle_text_color=”#004E5B” open_toggle_background_color=”rgba(0,0,0,0)” closed_toggle_background_color=”rgba(0,0,0,0)” icon_color=”#8C6239″ use_icon_font_size=”on” icon_font_size=”18px” _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” toggle_text_color=”#004E5B” toggle_font=”Lato|700|||||||” toggle_font_size=”18px” toggle_line_height=”1.6em” custom_margin=”||” custom_padding=”||” toggle_font_size_tablet=”18px” toggle_font_size_phone=”15px” toggle_font_size_last_edited=”on|desktop” border_width_all=”0px” border_width_bottom=”1px” border_color_bottom=”#e6e6e6″ global_module=”2814″ locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Policy” open=”on” _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”]

  • All reservations must be paid in full at the time of booking.
  • All reservations must be made by sending a full photo of their National Institute of Statistics (INE) identification for Mexican travelers and a passport for foreign travelers; these must be presented at check-in.
  • If the aforementioned identification, sent in PDF format or scanned and presented in physical form upon arrival at the hotel at check-in, does not match the primary guest’s identification, we do not reserve the right to refuse the reservation, even if it has been paid for.
  • The offered rate will be valid for 24 hours only.
  • There are no refunds or cancellations if the guest does not show up for check-in.
  • To make a change of date valid, 16 business days’ notice is required. This request will be subject to rate changes and room availability.
  • If the check-in and check-out dates are changed according to policy guidelines and the rate is lower, no refund will be issued for the change of dates.
  • Check-in Time: 3:00 PM
  • Check-out Time: 12:00 PM
  • The check-out tolerance is 30 minutes to avoid additional charges.
  • Late Check-out: 50% of the room rate will be applied to the daily rate until 2:00 PM.
    If the rate is later than 2:00 PM, the full amount of one night’s room will be charged at that day’s rate.
  • Any inappropriate behavior toward our staff or behavior that disturbs other guests will be grounds for leaving the hotel without a refund. In extreme cases, the police will be called.
  • No refunds or changes will be made due to weather conditions, hurricanes, flight changes, natural disasters, illnesses, or personal reasons.
  • Parking is free and subject to availability.
  • We are not responsible for accidents, theft, or loss of your belongings, or damage to third parties.
  • We reserve the right to request that you leave the property if you fail to comply with our policies and regulations.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title=”Pool Use” _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}” open=”off”]

  • Children, youth, and adults are allowed in the oceanfront pool.
  • The Jacuzzi located on the “Selvamar” Rooftop is for use by guests 18+ only.
  • SMOKING IS NOT PERMITTED IN ENCLOSED AREAS, SUCH AS ROOMS OR COMMON AREAS WITH A ROOF, NOR INSIDE A POOL OR JACUZZI.
  • BEVERAGES OF ANY KIND ARE NOT PERMITTED IN THE POOLS OR JACUZZIS.
  • A FEE FOR LOST OR TAKEN TOWELS FROM THE HOTEL IS USD 150.
  • IN CASE OF ANY DAMAGE TO THE PROPERTY, THE AMOUNT TO BE CHARGED WILL BE THE COST OF THE REPAIR AND AN ADDITIONAL USD 250.
  • THANK YOU FOR YOUR UNDERSTANDING.
  • WE WISH THAT HARMONY REIGNS AT AZUCAR HOTEL TULUM AND THAT EVERY TRAVELER AND GUEST HAVE AN EXCELLENT STAY.
